lede: What I would build next, ranked by how much it makes the system more real. Each idea says why it matters and which roadmap items it builds on. Ideas are not promises; the status says where each one stands.

groups.label: Next
groups.text: Closest to the evidence a reader can check.

groups.label: Later
groups.text: Valuable, but needs a decision or an input first.

groups.label: Parked on purpose
groups.text: Deliberately not automated or not yet safe to.

ideas.title: Wire two signed-in approvers into the page and queue
ideas.why: The rule is enforced and tested in the runner, but the shipped page still takes one approval. Wiring it makes the strongest control visible end to end.

ideas.title: Replay the approval flow against the per-client audit chains
ideas.why: Audit chains are now one per client. The site's replay and the browser verifier should show that, so the proof matches the current design.

ideas.title: Type-your-own-text injection check in the browser
ideas.why: Lets a visitor try to fool the tripwire themselves. Needs the detector ported to the browser or a small WebAssembly build; measured cost and compatibility are still unknown.

ideas.title: Security evidence bundle per client
ideas.why: Turns audit records, approvals and change notes into a reviewable pack. Shows how the program supports an audit without claiming one.

ideas.title: Monthly client health report with reconciliation
ideas.why: A report whose every number is re-derived from raw records fails loudly when it is wrong. It is the clearest example of verified output.

ideas.title: Real Entra sign-in test against a test tenant
ideas.why: Replaces the mock issuer with a Microsoft-issued token and checks the assumed claim names. Needs a test tenant and an explicit yes.

ideas.title: Cited retrieval with per-client namespaces
ideas.why: Answers drafted only from the right client's documents, with refusal and leakage evals. Needs a retrieval store decision.

ideas.title: MCP server over approved levers
ideas.why: Exposes only registered, scoped, audited levers to any compatible assistant, so the safety model travels with the tool.

ideas.title: Eval gates in CI with routing thresholds
ideas.why: A change that makes triage worse should fail before merge. Needs labelled data that more than one person wrote.

ideas.title: Teams approval card and Outlook draft mocks
ideas.why: Meets approvers where they work while keeping the same checks. Mock first; no real tenant.

ideas.title: Project timeline page for the whole portfolio
ideas.why: Shows how projects relate and what each taught the next one.

ideas.title: Any connection to a real tenant, PSA or backup system
ideas.why: Synthetic data only until there is a test tenant and written approval.

ideas.title: Hosted models on client data
ideas.why: The gate stays closed until a provider's retention and contract terms are approved in writing.

ideas.title: Ranking people from AI output or ticket metrics
ideas.why: Deliberately not built. A test is planned to ensure no export carries a per-person column.
